title: Shortest Path with BFS
subtitle: Follow a queue through a graph. Try a cycle or a destination that cannot be reached.

edgeCases.label: Cycle
edgeCases.why: Seen nodes cannot re-enter the queue.

edgeCases.label: Disconnected
edgeCases.why: An empty queue can leave some nodes unreachable.

derivation: V is the number of vertices (nodes); E is the number of directed edges.
With adjacency lists, each reachable node is enqueued once and each outgoing edge is checked once. Advancing the queue head costs O(1); no array shifting is needed.
Map lookups take expected O(1). The queue and distances store at most V entries. These bounds describe the shown algorithm, excluding the input graph and visualization snapshots.
